verdict.rationale: Claude Cowork and scheduled tasks support delegating multi-step tasks and recurring work, and Research performs multi-step agentic searches, which imply some capacity for handling many items in a workflow, but there's no documented feature for explicit bulk/batch operations across many discrete items (e.g., batch file processing, bulk edits, mass data transformations) as a first-class capability. missing for 10: explicit bulk/batch-operation feature documentation, evidence of processing large item sets (e.g., hundreds of files/records) in a single operation, and independent hands-on confirmation of bulk-operation reliability.
